comparison.objective: Fill a bath while enforcing cold-first activation and hot-first shutdown.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered bimanual lever rotation and state monitoring; no tool alignment, impact, fracture, or fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Hot water running without cold at either transition permanently zeros the run; partial stages cover cold on, both on, and fill level. Exact final fill and lever tolerances are not given in the record.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-critical action ordering on controls, unrelated to the candidate’s physical fracture-and-containment outcome.
